content.introduction: According to Bloomberg's sector performance data, the Health Care sector has a weight of 10% and a percentage change of 0.30% as of November 5, 2026. The Health Care Equipment & Services and Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences sub-sectors also feature with weights of 32% and 68% respectively, and percentage changes of 4.32% and 2.43%. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the overall performance of the Health Care sector beyond these figures.
